title: Supporting information: Phytate-hempseed oil body interactions: effect of pH on colloidal, thermodynamic, and spectroscopic properties
description:
Code, inputs and data for reproducing the simulation, theory and ITC/zeta-potential analyses in the associated manuscript (in preparation). Contents: Monte Carlo (Faunus) inputs and extracted potential-of-mean-force, potential and charge profiles for phytate near an oleosin peptide brush; a lateral-correlation adsorption-regulated Poisson-Boltzmann (LC-AR-PB) model; measured zeta potentials; raw ITC exports and binding fits. Every figure and reported table rebuilds from a clean checkout with uv run make_figures.py.
